mentions.name: Research-focused cardiovascular wearable
mentions.description: A research-focused wearable device for cardiovascular studies. It aims to give researchers access to raw sensor data, expand sensing modalities, and improve data quality for longitudinal research into diseases that present through cardiovascular mechanisms, as an alternative to consumer wearables whose hardware is built for low-cost consumer use rather than open-ended research. The build process and embedded C work are documented on the author's blog.
mentions.problem: Wearable research at scale is nearly impossible outside large companies: raw data from consumer wearables is often inaccessible, longitudinal studies suffer data dropout issues, and companies treat longitudinal datasets as valuable and keep them closed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been blogging about learning embedded C, while building a wearable device for cardiovascular research.

I'm trying to improve access to raw data, expand the sensing modalities, and improve data quality for studies in to diseases that can present through cardiovascular mechanisms.
mentions.author: skoopsy
